name: greeter
description: A small Go HTTP service exposing GET /hello?name=X, returning a JSON greeting for the given name (or a generic greeting when name is omitted). Stateless — it persists nothing and calls no other component. Follows the project layout and conventions in app-factory-kaj/e2e-reference (cmd/<service>/main.go entrypoint, internal/<pkg> for logic, JSON errors, net/http only).
